tool_args.rationale: The pilot spans only H=0.16–0.48, while the target is H=20.3. Sink dependence and positive short-window gain are consistent with the archived sink-coupled adaptation mechanism, but its slow timescale is not identifiable from this pilot alone. The slow-horizon probe directly resolves that ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations do not identify five parameters reliably or constrain the slow adaptation at the target horizon.
Fine short-time trajectories are less directly informative about slow reversal and long-horizon behavior.
The auxiliary measurement is irrelevant to identifying the proposed mechanism.
